title: We Play to Win (House of Mirrors Rally)
summary: Vivienne and Liliane play ping-pong in a ruined ballroom. Plaster falls. They do not flinch. Pizza box on the intact half of the table.
visualArc: Chandelier ballroom → rally → plaster dust → chin tilt → split table + pizza.
